# Sao Tome and Principe

Wealth gradients in fertility and mortality: the values for an OG-Core calibration, followed by the estimates they are based on. Terms are defined in the [glossary](../glossary.md).

## Values for OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Wealth gradient | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | −0.69, by age as below | MICS 2019, TFR, plus [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md) |
| `infmort_gradient` | −0.49 | MICS 2019, infant mortality rate |
| `mort_gradient` | 2.91 − 0.425 × ln(GDP per capita, PPP) | [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md), GDP per capita in constant 2021 international $; for example −0.32 at $2,000 and −1.01 at $10,000, each with a 95% prediction interval of about ±0.7 |
| `imm_pctiles` | not provided | — |

Values are [wealth gradients](../glossary.md#wealth-gradient). Before they are passed to OG-Core, each is divided by 100 × (1 − p), where p is OG-Core's rate at that age ([details](../methods/ogcore-units.md)).

**Fertility gradient by age of mother** (`fert_gradient`; ages below 15 use the 15–19 value, ages 50 and above the 45–49 value):

| 15–19 | 20–24 | 25–29 | 30–34 | 35–39 | 40–44 | 45–49 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.46 | −0.79 | −0.48 | −0.36 | −0.59 | −1.08 | −1.67 |

## Estimates

### Household surveys

Latest Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) or Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) with a complete wealth-quintile breakdown, for each indicator ([`gradient_library_latest.csv`](../../data/gradient_library_latest.csv); earlier surveys in `gradient_library.csv`). MICS rates are taken from the World Bank's compilation of survey results by wealth quintile ([sources](../sources.md)).

| Indicator | Survey | Lowest | Second | Middle | Fourth | Highest | Low/high ratio | Gradient |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Total fertility rate (births per woman) | MICS 2019 | 5 | 4.2 | 3.9 | 3.4 | 2.8 | 1.79 | −0.69 |
| Infant mortality rate (per 1,000 live births) | MICS 2019 | 20 | 13 | 11 | 6 | 18 | 1.11 | −0.49 |
| Under-five mortality rate (per 1,000 live births) | MICS 2019 | 28 | 17 | 13 | 9 | 19 | 1.47 | −0.71 |
